facts.fact: BCEAO Instruction No. 001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024 governs payment services across UMOA and requires providers to be licensed, with the compliance deadline extended to 31 August 2025, per Agence Ecofin.
The instruction obliges fintechs to hold a licence, with capital of 10 to 100 million FCFA, and four providers were licensed in Cote d'Ivoire by 27 May 2025.
